import json,os
from pathlib import Path
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.chrome.service import Service
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By
from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait,Select
from selenium.webdriver.support import expected_conditions as EC
state=json.loads(Path(os.environ['CREW_PEOPLE_STATE']).read_text())
url=os.environ['CREW_PEOPLE_URL']
options=webdriver.ChromeOptions()
options.binary_location='/usr/bin/chromium'
for value in ['--headless=new','--no-sandbox','--disable-dev-shm-usage','--window-size=1440,1000']:options.add_argument(value)
driver=webdriver.Chrome(service=Service('/usr/bin/chromedriver'),options=options)
wait=WebDriverWait(driver,8)
checks=[]
def text_element(tag,value):return driver.find_element(By.XPATH,'//'+tag+'[normalize-space()='+json.dumps(value)+']')
def button(value):return text_element('button',value)
def field(label):return driver.find_element(By.XPATH,'//label[span[normalize-space()='+json.dumps(label)+']]//*[self::input or self::textarea or self::select]')
def change(label,value):
    element=field(label);element.clear();element.send_keys(value)
def go(route,title):
    driver.get(url+'/#'+route)
    wait.until(lambda d:d.find_elements(By.TAG_NAME,'h1') and d.find_element(By.TAG_NAME,'h1').text==title)
try:
    go('/login','Welcome back')
    change('Email',state['clients']['owner']['email']);change('Password',state['clients']['owner']['password']);button('Sign in').click()
    wait.until(lambda d:'Welcome,' in d.find_element(By.TAG_NAME,'main').text)
    checks.append({'name':'People browser signs in with persisted owner password','ok':True})
    go('/account/tokens','Personal API tokens')
    change('Token name','Browser private token');button('Create token').click()
    wait.until(lambda d:d.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'textarea[readonly]'))
    assert driver.find_element(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'textarea[readonly]').get_attribute('value').startswith('crew1.api.')
    button('I have saved it; hide token').click()
    assert not driver.find_elements(By.CSS_SELECTOR,'textarea[readonly]')
    row=wait.until(lambda d:d.find_element(By.XPATH,'//tr[td[normalize-space()="Browser private token"]]'))
    row.find_element(By.XPATH,'.//button[normalize-space()="Revoke"]').click();wait.until(EC.alert_is_present());driver.switch_to.alert.accept()
    wait.until(lambda d:'revoked' in d.find_element(By.XPATH,'//tr[td[normalize-space()="Browser private token"]]').text)
    checks.append({'name':'People browser creates hides and deliberately revokes personal token','ok':True})
    go('/orgs/'+state['orgId']+'/audit','Organization security audit')
    Select(field('Entity type')).select_by_value('invitation');button('Apply filters').click()
    wait.until(lambda d:'accepted' in d.find_element(By.TAG_NAME,'main').text)
    button('View changes').click()
    wait.until(lambda d:d.find_elements(By.XPATH,'//section[@aria-label="Audit event details"]'))
    checks.append({'name':'People browser filters persisted invitation security audit','ok':True})
    go('/orgs/'+state['orgId']+'/teams','Acceptance Team · Teams')
    wait.until(lambda d:button('Next page').is_enabled());button('Next page').click()
    wait.until(lambda d:'Page 2' in d.find_element(By.TAG_NAME,'main').text)
    button('Previous page').click();wait.until(lambda d:'Page 1' in d.find_element(By.TAG_NAME,'main').text)
    checks.append({'name':'People browser next and previous cursor pages browse full team list','ok':True})
    go('/teams/'+state['browserTeamId'],'Browser administration')
    change('Description','Browser persisted description');button('Save team').click()
    wait.until(lambda d:'Team saved.' in d.find_element(By.TAG_NAME,'main').text)
    button('Delete team').click();wait.until(EC.alert_is_present());driver.switch_to.alert.dismiss()
    assert driver.find_element(By.TAG_NAME,'h1').text=='Browser administration'
    checks.append({'name':'People browser saves team form and cancels destructive deletion','ok':True})
    go('/account/security','Account security')
    change('Current password','wrong password');change('New password','browser replacement password');change('Confirm new password','browser replacement password');button('Change password').click()
    wait.until(lambda d:'Current password is incorrect' in d.find_element(By.TAG_NAME,'main').text)
    assert field('New password').get_attribute('value')=='browser replacement password'
    checks.append({'name':'People browser password errors keep form input and explain field failure','ok':True})
    print(json.dumps({'ok':True,'checks':checks}))
finally:driver.quit()
